meaning:
ὁμολογουμένως
adv. (ὁμ oλογέω), [in LXX: 4Ma.6:31 4Mac 7:16 4Mac 16:1 * ;]
1. as agreed, conformably with.
2. confessedly, by common consent: 1Ti.3:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations…
